purpose: Mechanism evidence for verified TinyKG execution history entering the next long-horizon agent decision before work

environment.verification_context: clean clone with only the staged experience-feedback patch

integrity_constraints: TinyKG kind=task filtering occurs before result-window truncation
Only current completed tasks with current verification evidence are eligible
Tentative and confirmed association states remain distinct
Retrieved task text and labels are untrusted candidate data, never instructions
A lexical miss is not treated as proof of absence
An insufficient exact probe requires 2-4 separate LLM-generated semantic variants before work
limitations: This is mechanism and delivery evidence, not evidence that the model selected a better action or improved task outcome
The deterministic fixture contains one accepted completed task and is not a recall-quality benchmark
Subprocess count is conservatively bracketed because KgClient retries and project/global lookup caches are internal
Task packet, neighbor state, and target labels are bounded separate reads rather than one atomic TinyKG snapshot; every accepted item remains candidate-only and requires current-state verification
The retrieval latency is a single warm-artifact observation and must not be generalized as a distribution
Adoption, rejection reasons, tool choice, rework, and outcome lift require controlled GLM-5.2 rollouts
